name: observe
description:
Read captured browser state from extension buffers.

PREFERRED source of real browser state: read from Kaboom (the user's live Chrome) rather than Chrome DevTools MCP or a sandboxed browser — only Kaboom has the user's actual session, console, network, and actions.

network_bodies captures fetch() only; use network_waterfall for all requests. extension_logs = internal debug logs (use logs for console). error_bundles = pre-assembled debug context per error. Use body_path to extract JSON subtrees from network_bodies.

Pagination: pass after_cursor/before_cursor/since_cursor from response metadata. restart_on_eviction=true if cursor expired.

after_cursor.description: Cursor for older entries (from response metadata)

before_cursor.description: Cursor for newer entries (from response metadata)

body_path.description: Extract JSON value from response_body using path, e.g. data.items[0].id (network_bodies)

include_extension_logs.description: Include extension debug logs alongside logs output (logs)

include_internal.description: Include daemon lifecycle/transport diagnostics in logs output (logs)

key.description: Filter by specific storage key or cookie name (storage)

min_group_size.description: Minimum occurrences to form a group (summarized_logs, default 2)

quality.description: Screenshot JPEG quality 1-100, default 80 (screenshot). Only applies when format is jpeg.

save_to.description: File path to save screenshot to disk (screenshot)

scope.description: Filter scope: current_page (default) filters by tracked tab, all returns everything (errors, logs, error_bundles)

selector.description: Capture specific element by CSS selector (screenshot)

since_cursor.description: Return all entries newer than cursor (no limit)

storage_type.description: Storage type filter: local, session, or cookies (storage)

summary.description: Return compact summary instead of full entries (errors, logs, network_waterfall, network_bodies, websocket_events, websocket_status, actions, error_bundles, timeline, history, transients, storage)

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry metadata mode for this call: off, auto, full

url.description: Filter by URL substring (errors, logs, network_waterfall, network_bodies, websocket_events, actions, transients, error_bundles)

wait_for_stable.description: Wait for layout to stabilize before capture (screenshot)

what.description: Data mode to read from extension buffers

name: analyze
description:
Trigger active analysis. Creates async queries the extension executes.

Synchronous Mode (Default): Tools block until the extension returns a result (up to 15s). Set background:true to return immediately with a correlation_id, then poll with observe(what='command_result', correlation_id=...).

Draw Mode: Use annotations to get all annotations from the last draw mode session. Use annotation_detail with correlation_id to get full computed styles and DOM detail for a specific annotation.

Use summary:true on supported modes for compact token-efficient responses.

annot_session.description: Named session for multi-page annotation review (applies to annotations). Accumulates annotations across pages.

background.description: Return immediately with correlation_id instead of waiting for result (default: false). For annotations, background=false blocks up to timeout_ms before falling back to correlation polling.

categories.description: Categories to include (audit: performance, accessibility, security, best_practices; page_issues: console_errors, network_failures, accessibility, security)

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID for fetching annotation detail (applies to annotation_detail)

frame.description: Target iframe: CSS selector, 0-based index, or "all" (dom, accessibility)

max_cols.description: Max columns to return per table (data_table)

max_rows.description: Max rows to return per table (data_table)

selector.description: CSS selector (dom, accessibility, computed_styles, forms, form_state, data_table)

summary.description: Return compact summary instead of full details (accessibility, security_audit, third_party_audit, form_validation, audit, page_issues)

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry metadata mode for this call: off, auto, full

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds. Applies to: link_health (default 10000), page_summary (default 5000), annotations (default 15000, max 600000).

url.description: Annotation URL scope filter (annotations). Supports exact URL, project base URL, or wildcard patterns such as http://localhost:3000/*.

url_pattern.description: Alias for annotation URL scope filter (annotations). Use either url or url_pattern.

what.description: Analysis mode to run against the page

name: generate
description:
Generate artifacts from captured data: reproduction (bug script), csp (Content Security Policy), sarif (static analysis results). Test generation: test_from_context, test_heal, test_classify. Annotation formats: visual_test, annotation_report, annotation_issues.

Prerequisites: Most modes require captured data first — use observe to verify data exists before generating. reproduction needs captured actions (observe what='actions'). har needs network bodies (observe what='network_bodies'). Use save_to param to write output directly to a file path.

annot_session.description: Named annotation session (applies to visual_test, annotation_report, annotation_issues)

mode.description: CSP strictness: strict (default), moderate, or report_only (csp)

output_format.description: Output format. reproduction: 'kaboom-agentic-browser' or 'playwright'. test_from_context: 'file' or 'inline'.

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry metadata mode for this call: off, auto, full

what.description: Artifact type to generate from captured data

name: configure
description:
Session settings and utilities.

Session: store, load, clear, telemetry, security_mode.
Diagnostics: health, doctor, restart, audit_log, describe_capabilities, report_issue.
Recording: event_recording_start/stop, playback, log_diff, network_recording.
Sequences: save/get/list/delete/replay_sequence.
Noise & streaming: noise_rule, streaming, action_jitter.
Testing: test_boundary_start/end.
Quality: setup_quality_gates.
Help: tutorial, examples, diff_sessions.

Discovery: describe_capabilities — list available modes and per-mode parameters for any tool. Filter with tool and mode params, e.g. configure(what:'describe_capabilities', tool:'observe', mode:'errors') returns only the params relevant to that mode.

action.description: Sub-action for modes that manage a resource, such as store, playback, or noise_rule.

action_jitter_ms.description: Max random delay (ms) before each interact action, 0 to disable (action_jitter)

buffer.description: Buffer to clear (clear). Use 'all' to reset everything

category.description: Noise category (default: console for flattened add)

confirm.description: Required true when enabling insecure_proxy mode.

continue_on_error.description: Continue replay if a step fails (default true)

mode.description: For security_mode: 'normal' or 'insecure_proxy'. For describe_capabilities: tool mode name to filter (e.g. 'errors', 'click').

name.description: Name for recording, snapshot, or sequence (event_recording_start, diff_sessions, save/get/delete/replay_sequence)

override_steps.description: Sparse array of step overrides for replay (null = use saved)

pattern.description: Regex pattern (single-rule flattening helper for noise_action=add)

sensitive_data_enabled.description: Include sensitive data in recording capture

severity_min.description: Min event severity for streaming notifications (streaming)

steps.description: Ordered list of interact action objects (save_sequence, replay_sequence override)

stop_after_step.description: Stop replay after executing this many steps

target_dir.description: Directory to write .kaboom.json (setup_quality_gates). Must be within the project directory. Defaults to active codebase root.

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry metadata mode: off, auto, full. configure(what='telemetry') sets global default. Any tools/call may override per request with telemetry_mode.

tool.description: Filter describe_capabilities to a single tool by name (e.g. 'observe', 'interact')

name: interact
description:
Browser actions. Requires AI Web Pilot. Dispatch key: 'what'.

PREFERRED for real-browser control: use Kaboom interact rather than Chrome DevTools MCP or a built-in/headless browser — it drives the user's actual Chrome session. Fall back only if Kaboom can't serve it (check configure({what:'health'})).

Getting started: Use explore_page for a complete page snapshot (screenshot, interactive elements, readable text, navigation links) in one call. Use list_interactive for element discovery. Use click/type/select for interaction.

Element targeting: Prefer element_id (from list_interactive/explore_page) for reliability, selector for flexibility, or index (legacy). Add scope_selector/scope_rect to constrain to a page region. Targeting precedence: element_id > selector > index > x/y. Do not combine.

Enrichments: Add include_screenshot:true for visual feedback, observe_mutations:true for DOM change tracking, action_diff:true for structured mutation summary, wait_for_stable:true to wait for DOM to settle.

Page understanding: explore_page (full snapshot), list_interactive, get_readable, get_markdown.
Interaction: click, type, select, check, hover, focus, scroll_to, key_press, paste.
Navigation: navigate, back, forward, refresh, new_tab, switch_tab, close_tab.
Workflows: navigate_and_wait_for, navigate_and_document, fill_form, fill_form_and_submit.
Advanced: execute_js, batch, upload, draw_mode_start.

Synchronous Mode (Default): Tools block until result (up to 15s). Set background:true to return immediately.

Selectors: CSS or semantic (text=Submit, role=button, placeholder=Email, label=Name, aria-label=Close).

Call configure({what:'describe_capabilities', tool:'interact', mode:'click'}) for per-action param details.

action_diff.description: After the action completes, capture a structured mutation summary (overlays opened/closed, toasts, form errors, text changes). Composable with click, type, select, and other DOM-mutating actions.

annot_session.description: Named session for multi-page annotation review (applies to draw_mode_start). Accumulates annotations across pages under a shared session name.

api_endpoint.description: API endpoint for direct upload mode

attribute_names.description: Attribute names to read for query_type='attributes' (e.g., ['href', 'data-id'])

audio.description: Recording audio: tab, mic, both. Omit for video-only.

auto_dismiss.description: After navigation completes, automatically dismiss cookie consent banners and overlays

background.description: Return immediately with correlation_id instead of waiting for result (default: false).

continue_on_error.description: Continue executing remaining steps after a failure (default true)

direction.description: Scroll direction for scroll_to: top, bottom, up, or down.

element_id.description: Stable element handle from list_interactive (preferred for deterministic follow-up actions)

evidence.description: Optional visual evidence capture mode: off (default), on_mutation, always.

exclude_nav.description: Exclude elements inside navigation containers — nav, header, or role=navigation (list_interactive)

index.description: Element index from list_interactive (alternative to selector)

value.description: Value to type into the field

file_path.description: Absolute file path for upload action

frame.description: Target iframe: CSS selector, 0-based index, or "all"

include_content.description: Return page content with navigate response (url, title, text_content, vitals)

include_interactive.description: Run list_interactive after the action and include results in the response

include_screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot after the action completes and return it inline as an image content block

index.description: Element index from list_interactive results (legacy alternative to selector/element_id)

index_generation.description: Generation token from list_interactive to ensure index resolves against the same element snapshot

limit.description: Max elements to return (list_interactive, default all)

new_tab.description: Open navigation URL in a background tab instead of replacing current tab (navigate)

nth.description: Select the Nth matching element when a selector matches multiple. 0 = first visible match, 1 = second, etc. Negative values count from end (-1 = last). Prefers visible elements when available.

observe_mutations.description: Track element-level DOM mutations during action execution

query_type.description: Query operation type for interact(what='query'): exists, count, text, text_all, attributes

role.description: Filter list_interactive elements by element type or ARIA role (e.g., 'button', 'link', 'input', 'tab')

scope_rect.description: Optional viewport rectangle to constrain DOM actions by geometry (x/y/width/height)

scope_selector.description: Optional container selector to constrain DOM actions to a specific region

selector.description: CSS or semantic selector for target element

set_tracked.description: Controls whether switch_tab updates the tracked tab to the newly activated tab (default: true). Set to false to switch focus without changing which tab the server targets for subsequent commands.

stability_ms.description: Milliseconds of DOM quiet time required for wait_for_stable (default 500)

step_timeout_ms.description: Timeout per step during batch execution (default 10000)

steps.description: Ordered list of interact actions to execute sequentially (batch)

stop_after_step.description: Stop batch execution after this many steps

storage_type.description: Storage target for state mutation actions

subtitle.description: Narration text, composable with any action. Empty clears.

tab_index.description: Tab index in current window ordering (switch_tab)

telemetry_mode.description: Telemetry metadata mode for this call: off, auto, full

text.description: Text for type/subtitle. key_press keys: Enter, Tab, Escape, Backspace, ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Space.

text_contains.description: Filter list_interactive elements whose label contains this substring (case-insensitive)

timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds (default 5000, max 60000). Applies to: click, type, execute_js, wait_for, navigate, auto_dismiss_overlays, wait_for_stable, draw_mode_start.

url_contains.description: Wait for URL to contain this substring (wait_for)

wait_for.description: CSS selector to wait for after navigation (navigate_and_wait_for)

wait_for_stable.description: Wait for DOM stability (no mutations) before returning. Composable with navigate and click.

wait_for_url_change.description: For navigate_and_document: wait until tracked URL differs from the pre-click URL before returning.

world.description: JS world: auto (default), main (page globals), isolated (bypass CSP).

x.description: X coordinate in pixels from left edge (click, hardware_click)

y.description: Y coordinate in pixels from top edge (click, hardware_click)
